design_overview: A modern, patient-centric hospital appointment booking system designed for both mobile and web platforms. The interface prioritizes clarity, ease of navigation, and accessibility for users of all ages. The design employs a clean, medical-professional aesthetic with calming colors, clear visual hierarchy, and intuitive touch-friendly components. Each screen is purpose-built to guide patients through registration, appointment booking, and management while providing doctors with efficient schedule management tools.

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen sizes from 375px to 428px width. Components use flexible layouts with percentage-based widths and max-width constraints. Touch targets minimum 44x44px following iOS HIG and Material Design guidelines. Horizontal scrolling containers for content overflow. Bottom navigation fixed for easy thumb access. Cards and modals adapt to screen height with scrollable content areas. Web version uses responsive breakpoints: mobile (<768px), tablet (768-1024px), desktop (>1024px) with adaptive layouts showing more content in wider viewports.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant design with minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text and 3:1 for large text. All interactive elements have clear focus states with visible outlines. Touch targets meet minimum 44x44px size. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Alternative text for all images and icons. Form inputs have associated labels. Color is not the only means of conveying information (icons and text accompany color coding). Keyboard navigation support for web version. Dynamic text sizing support for users with visual impairments. Reduced motion option respects system preferences.
animations: Subtle, purposeful animations enhance usability without distraction. Screen transitions use 300ms ease-in-out slides. Button presses show 100ms scale down to 0.95 with slight opacity change. Modal appearances use 250ms slide-up with backdrop fade-in. Toggle switches animate smoothly over 200ms. List items show ripple effect on press (Material Design) or highlight fade (iOS). Loading states use skeleton screens with shimmer effect. Success actions show brief checkmark animation. Pull-to-refresh uses native platform patterns. Scroll animations are smooth with momentum. All animations respect reduced-motion system preferences and can be disabled.
icons: Consistent icon system using outline style icons from Lucide or Feather icon sets. Icons are 24px by default, 20px for small contexts, 32px for large emphasis. All icons use consistent 2px stroke width. Icon colors match text hierarchy: text_primary for active, secondary for inactive, primary for selected states. Icons always paired with labels for clarity except in bottom navigation where labels appear below. Common icons: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person outline), settings (gear), bell (notification bell), bookmark (bookmark outline), heart (heart outline), filter (funnel), plus (plus sign), edit (pencil), trash (trash bin), share (share arrow).
